name: What is the typical lifespan of a water filter faucet and its components?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of a water filter faucet and its components?

acceptedAnswer.text: The lifespan of a water filter faucet itself is generally long-lasting, often comparable to a standard kitchen faucet, typically 10-15 years or more with proper maintenance. However, the internal filter cartridges require regular replacement, usually every 6-12 months, depending on water quality and usage, to maintain effective filtration. Ignoring filter replacement can lead to reduced water quality and potential clogs in the system.
acceptedAnswer.description: The faucet typically lasts 10-15+ years, but internal filter cartridges need replacement every 6-12 months for effective filtration.
